question: What owner have paid the most amount of money on his or her dog treatments? List the owners ID and full name.
gold_query: SELECT T1.owner_id , T1.last_name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id = T3.dog_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

steps.raw_response: {"sql": "SELECT o.owner_id, o.first_name, o.last_name FROM Owners o JOIN Dogs d ON o.owner_id = d.owner_id JOIN Treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id GROUP BY o.owner_id, o.first_name, o.last_name HAVING SUM(t.cost_of_treatment) = (SELECT MAX(total_cost) FROM (SELECT SUM(t.cost_of_treatment) AS total_cost FROM Owners o JOIN Dogs d ON o.owner_id = d.owner_id JOIN Treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id GROUP BY o.owner_id))"}
